However, the right infrastructure can empower creators to take control of their commerce without relying on restrictive platforms. This guide will walk you through setting up a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, leveraging Stack 02 for seamless payment processing and product delivery. Follow these steps to establish your store today.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often exclude creators in underserved regions due to economic instability or regulatory barriers. COREMERCH addresses this by providing a decentralized solution where you own your entire infrastructure. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, you eliminate reliance on third-party services, ensuring that your commerce operations remain resilient in the face of external challenges. This architecture is designed for creators who refuse to be held back by outdated systems.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your store, ensure you have a clear understanding of your product offerings and a domain ready for hosting. You will also need access to a NOWPayments account for crypto processing and a Cloudflare account for deployment. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script to manage your backend logic. With these components in place, you're equipped to build a secure and effective digital store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your Cloudflare Pages and setting up Cloudflare Workers to handle backend operations. Integrate NOWPayments to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions without KYC requirements. This allows you to accept multiple cryptocurrencies with low fees. Next, set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for product file delivery. This ensures that after payment confirmation, your customers receive their digital products automatically, creating a seamless purchasing experience.
You own everything after deployment; no platform controls your store.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it's time to test everything on the mainnet. Make sure payment confirmations are working and products are delivered as expected. Conduct a transaction with a small amount to verify the flow from payment to delivery. After confirming that everything operates smoothly, promote your store through social media and other channels, directing potential customers to your shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to start generating revenue.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is live and operational, consider leveraging the Edge Commerce Stack for additional features. This stack includes enhanced functionalities like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for secure email delivery, allowing you to build customer trust. Expand your product offerings and optimize your marketing strategies to attract a wider audience. Continuous testing and adjustments will help sustain growth and improve customer satisfaction.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize Cloudflare Pages to host your site and integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup allows you to bypass conventional payment systems and maintain full control over your store's operations. With a straightforward deployment, you can quickly establish your online presence.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Gather your product information and prepare your domain for hosting. Create accounts with NOWPayments and Cloudflare to manage payment processing and deployment. Set up Google Apps Script for backend functions and configure Cloudflare Workers for transaction handling. Ensure your product files are stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. Conduct testing to ensure seamless transactions and product delivery before launching your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store by using Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrating NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency payments. This allows you to bypass traditional payment barriers and maintain complete ownership of your online store.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script, allowing for a quicker deployment in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 leverages Cloudflare Pages and Workers for a more robust setup, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with end-to-end testing.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are suitable for hosting a digital product store. GitHub offers a simpler deployment process, while Cloudflare provides advanced features for scalability and performance.
What payment methods can I accept using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a wide range of digital currencies. This flexibility enables you to cater to different customer preferences and expand your market reach.
How do I ensure my store is secure from fraud?

To secure your store from fraud, implement HTTPS for your site, use secure payment processing through NOWPayments, and regularly monitor transactions for any unusual activity. Ensuring proper configurations with SPF/DKIM/DMARC will also help protect your email communications.
